title: Songwriter, rapper and producer Jam releases a new single called "Nightshift"
htmlContent:
Songwriter, rapper and producer Jam releases a new single called "Nightshift," a super record with a digestible sound and catchy hook anyone who listens can enjoy. He crafts together a one of a kind audio masterpiece with his song “Nightshift”.

The sound has a dark, beautiful, conflicted and trap sound that is truly one of a kind. Jam lets his songwriting skills shine on this incredible record, with a pen that progresses the story perfectly and delivered with a melodic approach, matched with a Rap cadence to complete the vision.
